title: Similar: Reservoir Ice-Out Timing Trend
goal: Analyze annual reservoir ice-out day-of-year observations and write a CSV that reports the long-term slope and p-value for the timing shift, so the user can tell whether spring breakup is happening earlier or later over time.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source domain with a single environmental time series, but removes attribution work so the decisive capability is estimating and interpreting a monotonic trend with slope and significance.
